facts.value: Archive operations distinguish several guarded outcomes. DAT parse failure reports an error and asserts. Public-symbol lookup always clears an output slot before lookup; missing symbols are either only reported or reported and asserted, depending on the wrapper used. Preload-aware loaders return true when the requested archive was already registered by the DVD layer and false when they had to allocate and load it, while still optionally returning the resulting descriptor. Archive release asserts that the descriptor is non-NULL and marked as independently owned before freeing it. Explicit relocation returns -1 for a NULL descriptor or a serialized-size/byte-order mismatch and returns 0 after successful section mapping and pointer relocation.
facts.rationale: The current opening directly preserves parse-failure handling and the two missing-symbol policies; the unaffected later source retains preload provenance, guarded destruction, and relocation outcomes.

evidence.why: Shows parse failure reporting and assertion plus fatal and nonfatal public-symbol resolution.
